fields.title: Tint Method
fields.description: Tint multiplied to the color. Tint method logic varies, but often refers to the "rain" and "temperature" of the biome the block is placed in to compute the tint.

fields.title: Particle Count
fields.description: Sets number of particles to spawn on block destruction.

fields.title: Texture
fields.description: The texture name used for the particle.

note: Available without experimental toggle in 1.21.100. The particle_count field controls how many particles spawn when the block is broken.
description: Sets the particles that will be used when block is destroyed.
